utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Jules asked for a hammer. I'll bring one along with my screwdriver set.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Leo! That'll be a big help. I'll make sure we have a spot for your tools.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it. I'll be there by 9 with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the community center thing! Sorry, I keep mixing up the details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No worries! It's this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center. Should be a fun morning of fixing things together!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday at 9, got it. I'll probably show up a bit late, but I'll be there!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, so Saturday morning around 9 at the community center works for you? We'll have coffee ready.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, 9 works. But tell me straight—will this repair drive actually get the fiber lines replaced, or are we just going to end up with a new coat of paint on the utility box?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Mina, don't worry—we've got a plan with the ISP to follow up on any major fixes we flag. This drive's about building momentum, not just touch-ups.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, the repair drive? Let me make sure I have the right one—did you mean the USB stick with the backup files or the one for fixing the router?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No, not a USB stick—a community repair event where we fix broken bikes and electronics instead of throwing them away!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Ah, that sounds great! So it's more of a fix-it workshop than a drive—do you know when the next one is happening?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think it starts at 10 AM sharp—I double-checked the flyer this morning.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, I'll bring my socket set and that portable workbench; we'll be ready for anything that comes our way.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I'll see you at the community center then—I'll bring some extra extension cords just in case.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Need me to pick anything up for your kit while I'm there?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks Ira, that's really kind—uh, but I'm not even sure what tools I'm supposed to bring. You got any idea what's needed?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, Vik mentioned hammers and screwdrivers are wanted. If you want, I can grab an extra set for you and drop it off on my way back.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, a repair drive! That does ring a bell now. I think I've got an old lamp somewhere in my garage that could use some fixing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Bring it to the drive on Saturday, I'm sure someone can fix it up for you!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday, you say? I'll try to remember that... but you might want to remind me again on Friday, just in case.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Quinn, I heard you're involved in that neighborhood repair drive. What's the plan?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rey! Yeah, we're fixing up the old fence and the swing set at the park—should be fun, and I'm trying to get everyone to join in!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds great, I can help with the fence if you need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You know, Cleo, they're setting up a little workshop space at the center too, so volunteers can actually fix things on-site.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, that's perfect! I was hoping we'd have a proper spot to work—brings back good memories from the last repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I know, right? And I heard they're even getting some retired electricians to come mentor folks—should be a real community effort.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Kira, I was just telling Ira about the repair drive this Saturday. We're fixing up old appliances and furniture for folks who can't afford repairs. I'm planning to bring my broken toaster and help out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, this Saturday? I thought it was next weekend.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, no, it's definitely this Saturday. I've been telling everyone—Ira, Oren—they're all bringing stuff.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I can come Saturday morning. Just point me at the tools and I'll get them sorted.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday morning sounds good, but let's triple-check that list before you start. I made a copy here with all the part numbers.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: All right, hand me the list. I'll make sure everything matches up before I touch a thing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Bo, yeah, the repair drive is finally coming together. Just a few more tweaks.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Tweaks, huh? I've got those old wrenches if you need 'em. Just point me where.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Bo, I might take you up on that. Just need to fine-tune the alignment, and then we'll see if she purrs.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Mina, I was just at the hardware store grabbing some stuff for the repair drive. Are you planning to stop by?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, I’m planning to. But tell me straight—do you think this repair drive will actually fix our street, or is it just window dressing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Well, I think it's a start—at least folks are showing up with tools. Better than nothing, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You know, Gus said he's got a shed full of old power tools he wants to donate—just needs a little TLC. That'd be a great start for the drive!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, that's perfect! If Gus can drop them off Friday evening, I'll have time to sort through them before the Saturday setup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I'll let Gus know to bring them by Friday evening then—he'll be thrilled to hear you're on top of the sorting!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard it's happening Saturday at the community center—just piecing together bits from different folks.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, Saturday! I think I remember now... wait, I should write that down somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, it's definitely Saturday—I think from 10 to 4, but don't quote me on that.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, just the power supply kept cutting out. But I think I finally swapped the right capacitors.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Dane, glad you got that fixed! You should bring it along to the repair drive this Saturday—we're fixing stuff for folks who can't afford it, and I'm bringing my toaster too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Haha, your toaster? That thing's older than my truck! But yeah, I'll bring the drive—might as well put it to good use.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Well, while you're here, could you show me the air compressor? I want to make sure it'll fit in my trunk just in case we need to split up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, it's right over here. Let me grab it for you.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey. Just set it down here so I can measure it against my trunk space.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait—Mina just asked about the router repair drive. Did you mean that one, Leo?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, same drive. I’m bringing tools. Jules asked for a hammer.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: A hammer? For a router repair? That seems odd—are you sure Jules didn't mean a screwdriver or something?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Tess, yeah I heard about that repair drive—I've got my truck packed and ready to head over.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Gus, great to hear you're all set! I've been rounding up a few more folks from my block—should be a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Well, the more the merrier, Jules. I'll swing by your place first and we can caravan over together if you want.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Saturday morning might work for me. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Eli hasn't given me a specific time yet, but I'm thinking maybe 8 or 9 AM would work well.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: 8 or 9 sounds fine. I can come by and see what needs sorting.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Eli! I'm so glad you're here — we've got Sam helping sort tools on Saturday, and it's going to be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, good. I like knowing who's where. So what time are we starting the sign-in table? I want to make sure everything's set before folks arrive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We're starting at 9 AM, so if you could be there a bit earlier to set up the table, that'd be great.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, you're Opal, right? I heard there's some repair drive—got any rusty tools I can dump off?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I'm Opal! The repair drive is Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center — they're definitely taking tool donations, so bring your rusty stuff by.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday at 10? Got it, I'll swing by with those wrenches. Thanks, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Kira, I'm so glad you're here! We're gathering at the community center at 9 AM this Saturday to fix up the park benches—can we count on your help?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, is this the same repair drive the Hendersons are running? I just want to make sure I've got the right details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, that's the one! We're all meeting at the community center at 9 AM on Saturday to lend a hand. I'd love to have you there!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Cleo, I know we talked about that repair drive... did I already tell you I'm bringing my old lamp? Or was that something else I was supposed to bring?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, the lamp! That's perfect—there was someone looking for parts to fix one just like it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Good, good, so I'm not mixing things up again. I'll be sure to dig it out of the closet before Saturday.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
